name.text: Which arrows are equal to a

questiontext.text:
\(\mathbf{a} = {@col(av)@}\). Four arrows p, q, r and s are drawn on the grid, each labelled at its tail. Is each one equal to \(\mathbf{a}\)?

generalfeedback.text:
